verdictBasis: The repair closes most of the original architecture forks: every previously escaping malformed PlanIntent now rejects, all seven PlanIntent commitments independently reproduce, stored-view target/query/result/retention substitutions reject, the DELIVERY overlay is total, all contribution/grant fields participate in exact equality, PROJECT-ID-V1 has one persisted logical owner, and physical isolation is honestly separated from lexical path vectors and retained as IMPLEMENTABLE_UNEXECUTED. The snapshot is not yet seal-ready. C-2's valid stored-read fixture and checker default use noncanonical request-1 and accept even an object-valued RequestId when both envelopes agree, contradicting live REQUEST-ID-V1. The retained PlanIntent validator also raises TypeError for several legal-JSON/wrong-schema nested values rather than returning deterministic pre-admission rejection. Storage makes QUARANTINED a durable purge state but has no recovery row for a crash after that state is persisted and before DELETE_IN_PROGRESS is persisted. IP-R4-04 and IP-R4-06 therefore both FAIL on this snapshot. Root-owned blueprint/register convergence remains pending and is reported separately; it is not used as the sole basis for either binding failure.

IP-R4-04.originalFindings: R7-C2-01 through R7-C2-04 are substantively repaired.
IP-R4-04.why: The declarative tagged request and equality design is now closed, but its retained executable boundary is not yet one deterministic implementation contract: stored reads accept a RequestId forbidden by the canonical owner, and hostile wrong-type JSON can escape as checker exceptions instead of the specified zero-attempt rejection.

IP-R4-06.originalFindings: R7-SN-01 and R7-SN-02 are repaired; R7-SN-03 is only partially repaired.
IP-R4-06.why: Logical ProjectId, canonical namespace paths, physical-assurance scope, and cross-root authority cutover are concrete. The full-project purge still has one reachable durable state with no recovery transition, so crash recovery can require an implementer-authored branch.

priorFindingDispositions.evidence: The tagged AnalysisIntentV1/AdmissionDescriptorV1 grammar now closes field sets, JSON value forms, identifiers, enums, non-empty sets, ordering, references, bounded parameters, and StageBudgetV1. Direct replay of null stageId, banana requiredness, empty ruleIds, empty relations, null contributionId, and the old untyped negative budget rejected; the exact-shaped negative budget also rejected.
priorFindingDispositions.qualification: A newly discovered totality defect in the retained validator is filed separately as R7R-C2-02 rather than erasing closure of every originally reported escape.

priorFindingDispositions.evidence: StoredViewIntentV1 is now a closed branch with PROJECT-ID-V1, sealed RunId plus manifest digest, four typed query branches, operation-compatible result selectors, and a closed retention selector. All seven target/manifest/query/result/retention/request-intent/attempt-identity negative binding fixtures rejected and the two second-process positives created no attempt or ExecutionPlan.
priorFindingDispositions.qualification: The request content/substitution defect is repaired. The separate contextual RequestId join defect is R7R-C2-01. Exact RunId derivation/custody remains an explicitly parked cross-lane identity dependency and was not silently treated as demonstrated here.

priorFindingDispositions.evidence: DELIVERY carries a closed fourteen-axis overlay. Independently derived C-2 source enums equal every disposition key set exactly. All nineteen denial cases and both allow controls were C-2-valid and produced their declared overlay decision/reason; this includes every eight one-field form that escaped the original review.

AdmissionDescriptorV1 now carries the complete twelve-field contribution and five-field grant records; AttemptRecord stores the exact descriptor; ExecutionPlan.planIdentityInputs is the exact thirteen-field PlanDescriptor join. Independent one-field substitutions of all 12 contribution fields and all 5 grant fields rejected with C2I-06, as did release, workflow, descriptor, intent, project, stage, and commitment substitutions.

PROJECT-ID-V1 is a persisted opaque 32-byte allocation owned by the host project resolver, with exact marker bytes, registry/marker custody, collision exhaustion, caller exclusion, move, ordinary clone, copied-marker, adopt/fork, and cross-machine rules. The marker hex and SHA-256 vector independently reproduced, and RI/C-2/TM all use ^prj1-[0-9a-f]{64}$.

The live contract no longer treats unequal strings as physical evidence. Lexical fixtures are explicitly LEXICAL_ONLY. Physical isolation separately requires regular-file observations, distinct stable file identity, link count one, transfer tracing, and a supported filesystem/operation matrix. Injecting physical-file IDs into a lexical fixture is rejected as shape drift, and a fake DEMONSTRATED promotion is rejected.
priorFindingDispositions.qualification: Physical product isolation remains SPECIFIED / IMPLEMENTABLE_UNEXECUTED with no demonstrationEvidenceIds and G14 undemonstrated. That honest later qualification gate is not an architecture-design failure.

priorFindingDispositions.evidence: Exact purge/quarantine paths, journal and marker fields, root inventory, a user-state authority record, generation-checked CAS, source/target authority ordering, rollback direction, five declared purge vectors, and ten migration vectors are now binding. Every declared vector matched its table and every action mutation rejected. All migration authority-cutover nonterminal states are covered.
priorFindingDispositions.residual: The purge operation persists QUARANTINED after the namespace rename, then separately persists DELETE_IN_PROGRESS. A crash between those durable writes produces QUARANTINED|canonical-absent|quarantine-present, but no recovery table row or fixture matches any QUARANTINED observation. The checker proves table/fixture bijection only; it does not prove coverage of every reachable durable nonterminal state.

priorFindingDispositions.evidence: architecture/06-evidence-and-persistence.md now shows the root marker, projects/control/quarantine topology, PROJECT-ID-V1, lexical-versus-physical assurance, and candidate status. IMPLEMENTER-BLUEPRINT.md has the repaired admission flow but its storage tree still omits storage-root.v1.json/control/quarantine and spells the cache as indexes/<fact-view-id> instead of the binding cache namespace. The freeze/register remain coordinator-owned candidate surfaces.
priorFindingDispositions.effectOnBindingVerdict: Reported separately as requested. Root-owned stale prose is not used by itself to fail either binding repair.

newFindings.title: The stored-read binding accepts a RequestId forbidden by its canonical owner
newFindings.statement: Live OPERABILITY binds REQUEST-ID-V1 to ^req1_[0-9a-f]{32}$ and requires a host-minted reserved RequestId for every stored-view request. C-2's explicit positive RequestContext and PreparedStoredRead use request-1; check-c2.py's defaults repeat request-1. validate_stored_view_binding checks only equality, so matching request-1 and even matching object values both validate. check-c2.py does not load OPERABILITY, while check-operability.py checks RequestId absence from semantic PlanIntent but not the contextual C-2 stored-read envelopes.
newFindings.impact: The two live contracts disagree on a positive executable vector, and the retained stored-read boundary can accept caller-shaped or noncanonical correlation identity. An implementer must decide whether C-2 equality or REQUEST-ID-V1 representation/ownership wins.
newFindings.requiredChange: Keep RequestId outside PlanIntent and every semantic commitment, but type both contextual envelope fields as live REQUEST-ID-V1. Replace request-1 defaults/fixtures with canonical host-owned values; reject non-string, malformed, caller-supplied, or unequal values; add a live C-2/OPERABILITY cross-check and retained negative mutations.

newFindings.title: Hostile wrong-type JSON raises exceptions instead of deterministic zero-attempt rejection
newFindings.statement: Direct calls with legal JSON but schema-invalid nested objects raised TypeError: object-valued resolvedConfiguration.path reaches set(config_paths), object-valued activationId reaches mixed sorting, object-valued contributionId reaches the authority tuple set, and object-valued grantId reaches the grant-id set. These are not parse failures; they are wrong JSON types within the exact input grammar. PS-15 says every malformed value rejects before ExecutionId/AttemptRecord, while the retained validator has no typed result for these inputs.
newFindings.impact: The executable oracle is not a total function over parsed JSON and can turn a caller-invalid request into an uncategorized checker/host fault. Normal and mutation selftests remain green because they do not include these type classes.
newFindings.requiredChange: Guard scalar types before collecting, sorting, hashing, or forming sets/tuples; make every parsed JSON value return validation errors without exception; add hostile object/array/boolean/null fixtures for each scalar collection key and selftest mutations proving zero-attempt rejection.

independentProbes.result: All 4 positive query branches committed exactly; 7/7 content/attempt substitutions rejected. In a separately constructed binding, canonical req1_00000000000000000000000000000001, invalid request-1, and invalid object {} were all accepted when equal across RequestContext and PreparedStoredRead.
12/12 contribution-field substitutions and 5/5 capability-grant-field substitutions in planIdentityInputs rejected with C2I-06. All 13 declared analysis-binding negative fixtures also rejected.

14/14 axis disposition key sets exactly equalled their live C-2 enum sources. All 21 fixture cases were independently C-2-valid and matched their overlay outcome: 19 denials and 2 allows. The original resident single/multi, repair, mutation, cloud/model, compiler-plugin, and project-hook probes all now deny with exact typed reasons before attempt admission.

The zero-allocation ProjectId, exact marker bytes, and marker SHA-256 reproduced independently. RI, C-2, and TM patterns are byte-identical. Positive vectors cover allocation, move, and ordinary clone; negatives cover caller supply, uppercase, copied-marker collision, tracked/unsafe marker, and eight-collision exhaustion.

Lexical object/ledger vectors validate only LEXICAL_ONLY paths. The separate qualification contract requires all five observation classes and five operation classes, has no demonstration evidence, and rejects a fake DEMONSTRATED promotion. No physical product assurance was inferred from checker success.

All 5 declared fixture/table pairs matched and 5/5 one-fixture action mutations rejected. State-prefix coverage independently found PREPARED, DELETE_IN_PROGRESS, and VERIFIED_ABSENT, but not reachable durable nonterminal state QUARANTINED; synthetic QUARANTINED|canonical-absent|quarantine-present had no mapping.

All 10 declared fixture/table pairs matched and 10/10 action mutations rejected. Every nonterminal authority/copy/retirement state has a mapping; source-root authority placement and automatic post-switch rollback mutations rejected. No migration cutover residual was found.
